mapper.delete: DELETE FROM login_otp WHERE member_id = #{memberId} OR reg_dt < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_otp (otp_key, member_id, code_hash, fail_cnt, expire_dt, use_yn, reg_dt) VALUES (#{otpKey}, #{memberId}, #{codeHash}, 0, NOW() + (#{expireMins} || ' minutes')::INTERVAL, 'Y', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT login_otp_id::TEXT AS row_id, otp_key, member_id, code_hash, fail_cnt::TEXT AS fail_cnt, use_yn, CASE WHEN expire_dt < NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS expired_yn FROM login_otp WHERE otp_key = #{otpKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE login_otp SET fail_cnt = fail_cnt + 1, use_yn = CASE WHEN fail_cnt + 1 >= #{maxFail}::integer THEN 'N' ELSE use_yn END WHERE login_otp_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE login_otp SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE login_otp_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
